<?php
/**
 * Test-only: makes application passwords usable in Playground.
 *
 * WordPress only offers them over SSL or on localhost, and Playground serves
 * over http://127.0.0.1.
 */

define( 'HM_TEST_APP_PASSWORDS', true );

add_filter( 'wp_is_application_passwords_available', '__return_true' );

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

$accounts = [];

foreach ( [ 'admin' => null, 'subscriber' => 'subscriber' ] as $login => $role ) {
	if ( $role === null ) {
		$user = get_user_by( 'login', $login );
	} else {
		$user_id = wp_insert_user( [
			'user_login' => $login,
			'user_pass'  => wp_generate_password( 20 ),
			'user_email' => $login . '@example.com',
			'role'       => $role,
		] );
		$user = get_user_by( 'id', $user_id );
	}

	list( $password ) = WP_Application_Passwords::create_new_application_password(
		$user->ID,
		[ 'name' => 'e2e-tests' ]
	);

	$accounts[ $login ] = [ 'user' => $user->user_login, 'password' => $password ];
}

file_put_contents(
	'/wordpress/wp-content/plugins/hm-rest-ability/.playground-credentials.json',
	json_encode( $accounts )
);
